h: Is there a scene your mind keeps going back to, even though it is over?

label: Today You Will Learn
h: How to tell replaying from repenting, and give a past event the response it actually needs.
body:
About 8 minutes, plus one short pause · one small practice · no homework list

This lesson is for regrets and mistakes, not for trauma. If a memory brings intense distress or a sense of reliving it, stop and speak with a qualified professional.

label: Key Scripture
h: "Forgetting what lies behind and straining forward to what lies ahead, I press on toward the goal for the prize of the upward call of God in Christ Jesus."

label: Meet Thomas
h:
Forgiven five years ago.
Still at the kitchen table every night.

label: Name The Pattern · Rumination
body:
RepentanceNames the wrong. Receives forgiveness. Makes repair. Lives differently.
RuminationReturns to the scene. Produces no new truth, repair or change. Keeps demanding suffering.

It is hard to recognise because it feels virtuous.

label: What The Replay Is Reaching For
body:
To undoReaching for a version where it did not happen. Fails every time.
To punishIf I cannot undo it, I can at least suffer for it.
To preventKeep it vivid and I will never do it again.
To understandLegitimate, until nothing new is found.

label: A Common Belief
h: "If I stop replaying it, I am letting myself off the hook. Feeling bad is the least I can do."
body: Continued suffering is not a payment. Accepting that it has been dealt with is taking God at his word.

label: The Tool · What Is The Past Asking For?
body:
RepairA safe, appropriate responsibility that remains.
LearnOne sentence to carry forward.
ContinueAn ongoing commitment, kept in the present.
ReleaseWhat cannot be altered, handed to God.

label: Back To Thomas
h: Repair is made. The lesson is written. The commitments are kept. The rest is released.
body: Show your mind the sentence, not the scene.

label: Do This Now
h: Take the scene your mind returns to most. Write which one it needs: Repair, Learn, Continue or Release.
body:
Then write one sentence for it. If it is Repair, write the first safe step, not the whole apology.

Pause the audio

label: Remember
h: It happened. It has been dealt with. I am not required to keep living in it.

label: Prayer
body:
Father, you know what I did.
I have confessed it.

I have done what I could,
and I am keeping what remains.

I trust that you have forgiven me.
Help me live forward.

Amen.
